notes.title: Free Weekend!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're asked Steam to make a free weekend event and now finally it comes out! Try to play multiplayer with your friend or face AI opponent in a battle! There are also 50% discount ;)

notes.title: New patch is out!
notes.notes:
- Added support for Windows x32 Bit
- Fixed game UI for the wide monitors (2560x1080 etc)
- Added text warning that you have to play online to get exp
